MAINTENANCE_DESCRIPTION: We have put our servers in the ice for a bit of regular maintenance. We'll be back in a few moments.
BATTLE_LOCK_POP_UP_MESSAGE_TEXT: There seems to be some problems with the connection. Please try again in couple minutes.
BATTLE_SERVER_CONNECTION_FAILED_POP_UP_M: Cannot connect to matchmaker or battle server. Please try again.
MATCH_LOADING_ASSETS: Moving bits and pieces in the internet...
PRACTICE_POP_UP_MESSAGE_TEXT: In practice mode you can try out a few different weapons without wasting ammo. No boosters or completing challenges possible!
CUSTOM_GAME_PRACTICE_DESCRIPTION: In practice mode you can try out few different weapons without wasting ammo.
CUSTOM_GAME_PRIVATE_DESCRIPTION: Invite your friends to a private game. Remember to share the game name with them!
HOST_LEFT_LOBBY_TEXT: The player that created this game has left.
NO_KEYBOARD_IN_FULLSCREEN: Keyboard is disabled when in full screen mode.
TUTORIAL_MOVE: Use the buttons at the bottom to move LEFT and RIGHT. Go for that ammo supplies crate.
TUTORIAL_OPPONENTS_TURN: It is now your opponent's TURN. Wait for it to end.
TUTORIAL_CHANGE_WEAPON: Change your weapon by tapping the WEAPON button.
TUTORIAL_SELECT_WEAPON: TAP the PISTOL to select it.
VIP_MEMBERSHIP_SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE: Buy time from below to activate the benefits.
LEVEL_UP_DESC: You have reached a new level!\nHere is your reward:
DROP_OUT_OF_MATCH_MESSAGE: You have been dropped from the match, but you still get to keep everything you collected before disconnecting.
ARMORPIERCINGROCKETDESC: Use it to shoot through objects but not through terrain.
BASICNUKEDESC: Deals small damage in a small area
BEANBAGDESC: Has a powerful knockback. Use it to push people and objects.
CLUSTERGRENADEDESC: Grenade that splits into smaller explosives. Useful on groups of enemies that are in cover.
CLUSTERROCKETDESC: Missile that splits into smaller rockets. Takes a second to deploy after firing.
DOOMSDAYDEVICEDESC: The ultimate weapon that can easily destroy a whole map. Very hard to avoid.
DRILLDESC: When thrown on the ground the drillbot digs a tunnel straight down.
DYNAMITEDESC: Dynamite drops at your feet and it has 4 second timer.
FRAGMENTATIONMISSILEDESC: Missile that leaves sharp fragments on the ground.
GRENADEDESC: Bounces around and has a 4 second timer. Useful on enemies that are in cover.
MEGANUKEDESC: Deals massive damage in a large area
MINIGUNDESC: Shoots multiple bullets in a relatively straight line.
MOLOTOVDESC: Shatters against surfaces to spread flames.
MORTARDESC: Works the same as bazooka but has greatly improved range.
PISTOLDESC: Shoots a bullet in a relatively straight line.
PLASMACANNONDESC: Shoots with a slight arc and is more effective the more accurate the shot.
PUNCHDESC: Use to punch your enemies off cliffs.
RAILGUNDESC: Use it to shoot through terrain and obstacles.
ROCKDESC: The heavy rock is useful for pushing people and for collapsing structures.
SHOTGUNDESC: Deals more damage depending on how close you are to opponents.
VOIDGENERATORDESC: Destroys massive amount of terrain and sucks in objects and players.
MINIBAZOOKADESC: Shoots a series of small missiles. Useful against groups of enemies or for collapsing structures.
NAPALMDESC: Napalm Canister drops at your feet and has a 3 second timer.
SNIPERRIFLEDESC: Long range projectile weapon that can fire through multiple enemies.
CINDERGRENADEDESC: Grenade that drops flames as it travels. Explodes after 4 seconds and will ignite opponents.
IMPACTCANNONDESC: Extremely close range weapon with huge knockback to both you and the opponent.
FLAREGUNDESC: Shoots a burning bullet in a slight arc. The bullet bounces around and can ignite enemies.
LASERPISTOLDESC: Effective against penguins, balloons and body hair.
PLASMAMORTARDESC: Unloads unspeakable plasmatic horror at a desired location.
FIREHOSEDESC: Disperses protesters and puts out fires, or both at the same time!
MININGLASERDESC: Instantly digs massive tunnels in any direction. Though it doesn't really harm penguins.
PLASMABOMBDESC: Unleash the awesome power of plasma with a controlled charge.
GRENADELAUNCHERDESC: Fires grenades faster than you could hope to throw them.
FUELAIRBOMBDESC: Detonates in the air and unleashes a rain of fire.
ARTILLERYSTRIKEDESC: Call in artillery support by placing this marker beacon.
WATERBALLOONDESC: It doesn't hurt much, but penguins don't like getting wet.
WANDWINDDESC: Shoots a slow moving tornado that pushes around enemies and objects. Ignores terrain.
FIREWORKSDESC: A short range rocket that creates a series of explosions.
CATDESC: Requires precise aim and causes enemies to be knocked around by an enraged feline.
MATCH_LOADING_BET_DESCRIPTION: Increase your bet during the match.
EXIT_MATCH_MESSAGE: You will not receive experience, coins or drops if you quit the match before it is over.
SALMONSUSHIDESC: Eat this yummy sushi to increase your attack power by 50%
SPICYSUSHIDESC: A red hot sushi roll that doubles your attack power.
WASABISUSHIDESC: Triple your attack power with this smoldering sushi treat.
SHIELDDESC: Block stuff with the shield. Lasts one hit!
UMBRELLADESC: The same umbrella Mary Poppins used. It slows your fall down. Lasts one turn!
SCROLLDESC: Causes an explosion around you that pushes stuff around. It's magic!
POGOSTICKDESC: Jumping is the next best thing to flying, ask any penguin. Lasts one turn.
BURRITODESC: Poison your foes with this gas emitting food.
KAMIKAZEDESC: If I'm going down I'm taking you with me!
CALTROPSDESC: Toss painful spikes around to slow down your foes.
MINEDESC: Mines that blow up when in contact with penguins.
FLAMEMINEDESC: Like a regular mine, but with more burning.
PROTEINBARDESC: Overcharges your weapons to shoot twice with one shot! Lasts one turn.
MUSHROOMDESC: If these go unchecked for too long they will reproduce.
CONFETTIDESC: Celebrate the new year with this colorful party favor.
